claimBoundary: Broader selected Lean typecheck-with-sorry guard only; generated files typecheck with sorry placeholders still present, and there is no Lean proof, compiler correctness, formal equivalence, public readiness, publication, runtime performance, hardware, or all-target readiness claim.
nonClaims: FEF-P17 records a broader selected Lean typecheck-with-sorry probe for generated Lean artifacts.
FEF-P17 may report Lean typecheck success only for files whose proof bodies still contain sorry placeholders.
FEF-P17 does not claim discharged Lean proofs.
FEF-P17 does not claim compiler correctness or formal semantic equivalence.
FEF-P17 does not publish a package, enable checkout, or claim production readiness.
FEF-P17 does not claim runtime performance, Verilog, zkproof, silicon, hardware, or all-target readiness.
reviewHighlights: Local MachLib .lake build artifacts are present and used through LEAN_PATH.
MachLib imports resolve for the selected generated Lean artifacts.
Eight selected generated Lean artifacts typecheck with sorry placeholders present.
The fixture family expands from 3 to 8 files and from 5 to 15 theorem stubs.
title: FEF-P17 Broader Lean Typecheck With Sorry
